The physics of plasma instabilities, energy losses, and containment challenges mean that sustaining fusion-relevant conditions for more than brief moments continues to elude researchers. Claims of 22-minute plasma durations at 50 million degrees would represent controlled fusion achievement—something that simply hasn't happened yet. Statement 2 accurately captures where fusion technology actually stands today.
